_note: PAPER TRADING ONLY. No wallet, no keys, no orders are ever placed. Public data only.

scalp_2pct.label: Static 2% scalp ladder, all profit kept as XRP

scalp_2pct_rlusd.label: Static 2% scalp ladder, profit banked in RLUSD (variant)
scalp_2pct_rlusd._note: Paper variant of scalp_2pct: same grid, each round trip sells enough XRP to bank the whole profit in RLUSD savings; savings are not recompounded into the ladder.

xrp_stacker.label: XRP stacker: sell slices high, buy back lower with all the RLUSD (goal: more XRP)
xrp_stacker._note: Separate $100 line (not in the $300 total). Starts 100% XRP. 4 slices x 15% of the sellable stack at +4/+8.2/+12.5/+17% above the reference; each rebuys 4% lower with ALL its RLUSD. 0.25%/fill = AMM 0.205% + slippage. Trails down when nothing is parked; slice parked >14 days is rebought at market. Replayed from the Oct 20 start on Bitstamp 5-min candles.

xrp_stacker_6pct.label: XRP stacker 6% steps (side-by-side test): sell slices high, buy back 6% lower with all the RLUSD (goal: more XRP)
xrp_stacker_6pct._note: Separate $100 line (not in the $300 total), side-by-side copy of xrp_stacker with 6% steps instead of 4%. Starts 100% XRP. 4 slices x 15% of the sellable stack at +6/+12.4/+19.1/+26.2% above the reference; each rebuys 6% lower with ALL its RLUSD. 0.25%/fill = AMM 0.205% + slippage. Trails down when nothing is parked and price is 6% below the reference; slice parked >14 days is rebought at market. Replayed from the Oct 20 start on Bitstamp 5-min candles.

amm_lp.label: AMM liquidity provider, $100 split 50/50 into the XRP/RLUSD pool (paper)
amm_lp._note: Tracked separately from the strategies above; NOT included in their totals or vs_baseline_pct. Two-asset proportional deposit (no AMM fee); XRP half bought with the same 0.05% taker cost as the baseline.

_sizing: Since 2026-10-24: each grid strategy has its own $100 (paper total $300), each compared with 'keep $100 in XRP' bought at the Oct 20 start. amm_lp is a separate $100 line.
